notes:
Account overview: BeaconShield Support Labs is the centralized contact center technology org for a payments processor that handles card-present and card-not-present flows. Heavy PCI scope; also runs a small lender arm with PHI in support transcripts. They operate a mix of cloud-hosted contact centers and a set of private datacenters.

Customer constraints: VPC-first approach — cannot use public multi-tenant hosted API for any PCI/PHI traffic. Preference: Redwood Private (VPC) with optional on-prem connector for air-gapped batch tasks. Must present HSM/KMS design and audit log retention policy (3+ years). SSO via SAML + SCIM provisioning mandatory.

Requirements summary (from sales & SE notes):
- Workloads: real-time agent assist (chat + tool calling), post-call ticket summarization, fraud reranking of suspicious transactions, automated triage for high-volume spikes.
- Latency targets: p95 <200ms for agent assist lookups; cold-start tokenization and reranking allowed up to 500ms for async jobs.
- Throughput: baseline 250 req/s across US East, spikes up to 2k req/s during peak incidents (Black Friday-like).
- Cost sensitivity: wants 30-40% unit cost improvement vs current hosted vendor for embeddings/recall layer; open to reserved capacity for predictable traffic.
- Model prefs: open to quantized Llama-family variants for reranking; prefer Redwood-verified catalog and ability to pin to model SHAs.
- Routing/Fallback: must support regional failover and automatic fallback to smaller quantized model during capacity shortages; business rule: no external fallback for PCI-marked requests.

Security & compliance notes:
- CISO comment: "We will not tolerate private data leaving VPC. Show us KMS/HSM, key custody, and audit chain."
- Data retention: legal expects retention controls + purge workflows; e-discovery hooks required for subpoenas.
- Audit logging: 3+ years retention for request/response hashes, with redaction tooling for sensitive fields.
- Pen tests & attestations: will request Redwood's most recent penetration test report and a SOC2 Type II attestation.

POC success criteria (agreed):
- Deployed private VPC instance + per-request audit logging enabled; evidence of key rotation via HSM.
- End-to-end agent assist p95 <200ms on 95% of synthetic traces at baseline load.
- Ticket summarization accuracy >75 F1 on internal eval set and no leakage of PAN/SSN in outputs (automated tests).
- Demonstrated graceful degradation: during a simulated 2k RPS spike, system maintains <400ms median and falls back without exposing PCI traffic to external models.

- CISO: "Can you provide an HSM diagram and the cert for the KMS provider? We need it for our vendor risk board."
- Support Ops Lead (quote): "If reinserts work we can cut average handle time by 18% — but it cannot increase PCI exposure."
